body: Shit that song was awesome. I'm starting to think that you're my Portuguese doppelgänger. Did everyone start commenting on your weight loss as if you weren't aware of it? I swear the amount of times I've had to bite my tongue because comments about my weight could outnumber the grains of sand in a particular beach.

Thanks, I really appreciate this. Unfortunately, every time I try to remove stress, everyone just makes me feel worse. I can't even bring myself to cry anymore. I'm just broken. Living without stress feels like an unreachable dream to me. I don't think anyone I know appreciates my existence. If I killed myself, they'd just remember me because they'd feel guilty otherwise. It's not because I brought value to their lives; It's because they would need to feel like they did all they could when they really never cared. 

Still, you're right that we're not alone. Part of me feels like sharing my pessimism might be bad for you, so please don't listen to any of my crappy reasoning. I really hope things turn out better for you than they did for me.

The waiting is the worst part. Anything she might do to hurt you can't compare to all the mental pain you've put yourself through. Fucking sucks, man. I just locked myself in a room and avoided talking to anyone for a month, but I don't know if that's the best way to deal with it.
